name: Paperback party
description: A flat yellow paperback in thick black outline with a black-and-white striped spine, a red quarter-circle on its cover and a hard offset shadow, set off-grid against a cobalt circle, a red squiggle and a mint triangle.
choices: Memphis: flat clashing colour, stripes against saturated fills, primitive shapes off-grid and solid offset shadows, with no gradients or perspective
The scatter is kept to three shapes so the book stays the subject
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
